name: Slaughtered Lamb
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, the Slaughtered Lamb keeps a quiet, seedy tavern above a hidden warlock sanctuary.

sections.title: A Thin Disguise
sections.body: Dark corners and few patrons greet you at the Slaughtered Lamb, where barkeep Jarel Moor warns visitors to avoid the shadows. The warning is literal. Back passages descend to crypts and summoning circles below. There, human warlocks and transfer practitioners from Khaz Modan study fel arcana, beyond the disapproving eyes of the Church of the Holy Light and the Kirin Tor.

sections.title: The Noble's Tab
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock threatened to expose the warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. He said he would rally the House of Nobles and petition the throne for an investigation. Yet Wishock only wanted to escape a ruinous bar tab. Before his agitation drew real scrutiny, Zardeth of the Black Claw gave him a fatal concoction. Wishock was permanently silenced, and the haven's secrets were preserved.

faq.q: What actually goes on under the Slaughtered Lamb?
faq.answer: Catacombs beneath the tavern hide Stormwind's warlock sanctum. Demonology and shadow magic practitioners teach apprentices there, conduct summonings, and practice fel arts forbidden in the streets above.

faq.q: Does the Stormwind City Guard know about the warlocks?
faq.answer: Fel magic draws deep distrust from the Church of the Holy Light and the Mage Academy. So the coven keeps to secrecy and silences anyone who threatens to expose it to the royal authorities.

faq.q: Who was Lord Wishock, and what happened to him?
faq.answer: Lord Baurles K. Wishock was a nobleman and tavern regular who discovered the warlocks below. He stirred the House of Nobles and sought a full investigation, hoping to petition the king to close the establishment.

faq.q: Why do gnome warlocks come here?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, its warlock masters moved to Ironforge, where Magni watches them closely. Lago Blackwrench sends novices to Gakin the Darkbinder at the Slaughtered Lamb for training.

angles.text: The catacombs below are your main sanctuary in Stormwind. They offer class trainers, demon-binding rituals, and tasks essential to mastering the dark arts.
The Alliance champions the Light and order, yet the Slaughtered Lamb shows the kingdom tolerates dark magic in its shadows.
